inputs.text:
Let's be entirely clear about what is happening here: this is yet another glaring exposure of the systemic rot and institutional deceit within our immigration apparatus. We are looking at a targeted campaign where lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Think about the profound vulnerability of those folks simply trying to gain legal status, only to be systematically hunted down as they leave the very courtrooms meant to oversee their cases. 

This revelation, brought to light in a lawsuit challenging this predatory practice, lays bare the bad-faith tactics deeply embedded in these agencies. Federal prosecutors revealed that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show. Yet, despite this complete lack of legal backing, they brazenly cited it anyway to justify the mass arrests of thousands of human beings. This isn't just bureaucratic overreach; it is a calculated assault on marginalized communities and a blatant disregard for due process that demands immediate, radical institutional reform.
